title: Intrinsic
description: A bunch of QoL and technical improvements for Minecraft Vanilla. Client Sided.
body:
![Intrinsic logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/89e2b184440945ffde5d77c4d81b6cd382ffacd8.png)

# Intrinsic

**Intrinsic** is a *client-only* **Fabric** mod for Minecraft that
bundles over **80 quality-of-life improvements** into a single polished
interface.

---

## Main features

### Customizable HUDs (28 modules)
Coordinates, FPS, clock, day counter, biome, light level, potion timers,
XP progress, durability, waypoints, totem tracker, item counter,
Death Log (last 5 deaths), Death Coords, Portal Coords
(Overworld ↔ Nether conversion), Bookshelf Power, Hotbar Tooltip,
Mob Health Bar, Damage Popup, Block Content Viewer (remembers chest /
shulker contents), Insomnia Tracker, Sleep Timer, Low HP Flash, armor /
hunger / bed-in-the-Nether warnings…

**Every HUD is repositionable** via a built-in drag-and-drop editor.

### Gameplay (27 modules)
- **Zoom**, **Fullbright**, **Sprint Toggle**, **Smooth Camera**
- **Freecam** (free camera, keeps the player's physics)
- **View Lock**, **FOV Unlock** (`/ifov 30..170`)
- **Auto-Eat**, **Auto-Totem**, **Auto Tool**, **Auto Respawn**,
  **Auto Refill**, **Auto Reconnect**, **Anti-AFK**
- **Armor Swap** (auto-equips the best armor piece)
- **Quick Stash** / **Inventory Sort** / **Junk Drop** (configurable blacklist)
- **Fast Place** / **Fast Break** (creative)
- **Chat Timestamps** & **Chat Highlights** (regex + sound ping)
- **Shulker Preview**, **Elytra Alert**, **Trajectory Preview**
- **Low Shield/Totem/Food/Potion** (lowers held items out of view)
- **Clean Screenshot** (HUD temporarily hidden during capture)

### Visual (9 modules)
No Pumpkin Overlay, No Vignette, No Fire Overlay, Hide Scoreboard,
No Weather, Particle Suppressor, No Fog / No Lava Fog / No Water Fog.

### Technical (18 modules)
Chunk Borders, Slime Chunks, Signal Strength (redstone), Ping, TPS/MSPT,
**Spawn Heatmap** (mob-spawnable surfaces), Entity Hitboxes,
Block Update Counter, **Villager Trades** + **Auto-Probe**
(silently captures offers), **Structure Outlines** (singleplayer),
**Piston Range Preview**, **Mob Highlight** (configurable ESP),
**Beacon Range** (128-block radius), **Crop Maturity Overlay**,
World Stats, **Spawn Sphere** (24/128 blocks), **Light Level Numbers**.

### Audio Tuning
Attenuate overly loud sounds (redstone, weather, mobs…) by category
or through custom patterns (prefixes on sound IDs).

---

## Interface

- Dedicated main menu (`Right Shift` by default) with sections:
  **Overview**, **All/HUD/Gameplay/Visual/Technical**, **Audio**,
  **Keybinds**, **Textures**.
- Drag-and-drop HUD layout editor (9 origin anchors + overrides).
- Built-in search across feature & keybind lists.
- Consistent dark theme, no dependency on Cloth Config / ModMenu.

---

## Commands

| Command | Action |
|---|---|
| `/iwaypoint` | Manage waypoints |
| `/ijunk` | Edit the Junk Drop blacklist |
| `/ifov <30..170>` | Override FOV |
| `/ispawnsphere` | Show/hide the spawn sphere |

---

## Requirements

- **Minecraft**
- **Fabric Loader**
- **Fabric API**
- **Java 25**
- **Sodium**-compatible

---

## Configuration

File created automatically on first launch:
`.minecraft/config/intrinsic.json`
